rationale: Accepted on the supplied remediation evidence: event/vault-authoritative reconstruction without projection authority; invite, approval, revocation, login, and session enforcement; native-only session ownership and fail-closed authenticated actor checks; secret redaction and serialization boundaries; and passing focused and workspace-wide gates. The evidence-only remediation supports implementation acceptance under SEC-AUTH-01 APPROVE_MINIMAL_DESIGN without requiring further production changes. This decision relies on the supplied evidence, not independent artifact or hash verification, and does not approve Linux/Windows packaging, final release, commit, or push.
